These metrics are known before the playoffs begin and are things the lab can analyze about a team's roster before the season starts.
>
> - **Net rating** reflects how well a team performs overall, based on points scored and allowed. It is a reliable indicator of a team's strength throughout the season.
> - **Top-player quality** measures the combined impact of the three best players on the team, as determined by the value model. This captures the team's reliance on its most impactful players during the playoffs.
>
> Winning percentage, while useful, is not as informative because it can be influenced by factors like schedule strength and luck, which are not as directly tied to a team's underlying performance or roster composition. The model prioritizes metrics that provide a clearer picture of a team's true capabilities and how they might perform in the playoffs.
